name: Cedar Bayou Auto Works

hero.title: Honest repairs, done right
hero.lead: ASE certified technicians, a call with the price before any work begins, and a 24-month warranty on the repair.
hero.imageAlt: A technician in a work shirt and cap smiling beside the open hood of a yellow SUV in the shop

warranty.title: 24 months / 24,000 miles
warranty.text: Parts and labor on every repair we make, in writing on your invoice.

certifications.title: ASE Certified
certifications.text: Technicians tested and certified by the National Institute for Automotive Service Excellence.

certifications.title: State Inspection Station
certifications.text: Texas vehicle safety inspections while you wait.

services.title: Maintenance
services.summary: Oil changes, fluids, filters and factory scheduled service.
services.text: Oil and filter changes, fluid flushes, belts, hoses and the factory service your owner's manual calls for, done on schedule so the expensive repairs never come up.
services.imageAlt: A technician checking the engine bay of a car under an open hood

items.title: Oil and Filter Change
items.text: Conventional, blend or full synthetic to your engine's spec, with a sticker for the next one.

items.title: Factory Scheduled Service
items.text: The 30, 60 and 90 thousand mile services from your owner's manual, without the dealer's markup.

items.title: Fluid Flushes
items.text: Coolant, transmission, power steering and differential fluid tested and changed when it is worn out.

items.title: Belts and Hoses
items.text: Serpentine belts, tensioners and radiator hoses checked for cracks and replaced before they leave you stranded.

items.title: Filters and Wipers
items.text: Engine air, cabin air and fuel filters, and wiper blades sized for your windshield.

services.title: Brakes
services.summary: Pads, rotors, calipers and brake fluid, measured before we replace them.
services.text: Grinding, a soft pedal or a shake when you stop. We measure pads and rotors, show you the numbers, and replace only what needs it.
services.imageAlt: A brake rotor and caliper on a car hub with the wheel removed

items.title: Pads and Rotors
items.text: Pads replaced in axle sets, rotors measured against the minimum thickness and resurfaced or replaced.

items.title: Calipers and Brake Lines
items.text: Sticking calipers rebuilt or replaced, and rusted hard lines bent and flared to fit.

items.title: Brake Fluid Flush
items.text: Old fluid absorbs water and boils sooner. We test it and flush the whole system.

items.title: ABS Diagnostics
items.text: ABS and traction lights scanned down to the sensor or module that set them.

items.title: Parking Brake
items.text: Cables, shoes and electronic parking brakes adjusted or repaired.

services.title: Engine and Diagnostics
services.summary: Check engine lights traced to the cause with dealer-level scan tools.
services.text: A check engine light is a code, not a diagnosis. We read it, test the part it points to, and tell you what failed and why before anything gets replaced.
services.imageAlt: A technician holding a diagnostic scan tool beside a car in the shop

items.title: Check Engine Light
items.text: Codes read, freeze-frame data reviewed and the fault confirmed with a test, not a guess.

items.title: Engine Performance
items.text: Misfires, rough idle, stalling and poor fuel mileage traced to plugs, coils, injectors or sensors.

items.title: Timing Belts and Chains
items.text: Replaced on schedule with the water pump and tensioners that wear alongside them.

items.title: Cooling System
items.text: Overheating chased to the radiator, thermostat, water pump or a leaking head gasket.

items.title: Emissions Repair
items.text: Oxygen sensors, catalytic converters and EVAP leaks fixed so the car passes inspection.

services.title: AC and Heating
services.summary: Cold air back before the Baytown summer gets here.
services.text: Warm air from the vents usually means a leak. We find it with dye and a sniffer, fix it, and recharge the system to the weight on the label under your hood.
services.imageAlt: Round dashboard air vents in a car interior

items.title: AC Recharge and Leak Test
items.text: System evacuated, leak tested under vacuum and recharged to the factory refrigerant weight.

items.title: Compressors and Condensers
items.text: Failed compressors, clutches and condensers replaced, with the system flushed and a new drier.

items.title: Blower Motors
items.text: Fans that only work on high, or not at all, fixed at the resistor, motor or control head.

items.title: Heater Cores and Blend Doors
items.text: No heat, a sweet smell or fog on the glass traced to the core or the door that mixes the air.

services.title: Tires and Alignment
services.summary: Tires mounted and balanced, and four-wheel alignments.
services.text: New tires mounted and balanced, flats patched properly from the inside, and a four-wheel alignment so they wear evenly and the steering wheel sits straight.
services.imageAlt: A technician in gloves fitting a tire onto a car

items.title: Tire Sales and Mounting
items.text: Major brands ordered to your size and mounted, balanced and torqued to spec.

items.title: Rotation and Balance
items.text: Rotated every other oil change and balanced when a vibration shows up at highway speed.

items.title: Four-Wheel Alignment
items.text: Set to factory specs, with a before and after printout.

items.title: Flat Repair
items.text: Punctures in the tread plugged and patched from the inside, the way the tire makers want it done.

items.title: Suspension and Steering
items.text: Shocks, struts, ball joints and tie rods replaced when they are worn past spec.

services.title: Electrical
services.summary: Batteries, alternators, starters and the wiring between them.
services.text: A car that will not start, a battery that keeps dying or lights that flicker. We load test the charging system and trace the wiring until we find the fault.
services.imageAlt: A technician testing a fuse box under the hood of a car

items.title: Battery Test and Replacement
items.text: Load tested in the bay, and replaced with a battery sized for your vehicle.

items.title: Alternators and Starters
items.text: Charging output measured and the starter draw tested before either one is replaced.

items.title: Battery Drain
items.text: Parasitic draws tracked circuit by circuit to whatever is staying awake with the key off.

items.title: Lighting and Wiring
items.text: Headlights, tail lights and wiring repaired, including rodent damage.

items.title: Power Windows and Locks
items.text: Window regulators, motors and lock actuators repaired or replaced.

expect.title: Drop it off or wait
expect.text: Bring it in at 7:30 or book a time. Coffee and Wi-Fi in the lobby if you stay.

expect.title: We call before we fix
expect.text: A technician inspects it and calls with what is wrong, what can wait, and the price.

expect.title: Drive away covered
expect.text: You pay what you approved. The repair carries our 24-month, 24,000-mile warranty.

makesText: Domestic and import cars, light trucks and SUVs, gas and hybrid. If it is not on the list, call and ask. The answer is usually yes.

about.title: A neighborhood shop with the tools of a dealer.
text: Cedar Bayou Auto Works opened on Garth Road in 2004 with two bays and one lift. It has six of each now, and the same rule it started with: nobody touches your car until you know what it needs and what it costs.

Our technicians are ASE certified and keep at it with training every year, because the cars keep changing. We work on daily drivers, work trucks and family SUVs, and we will tell you when a repair can wait.
about.imageAlt: A technician working at a bench in a clean auto repair shop
points: Coffee and Wi-Fi in the lobby

A technician working under a raised vehicle on a floor jack

band.title: Check engine light on?
band.text: Bring it by. A diagnosis tells you what it is before you spend a dollar fixing it.

reviews.author: Truck owner, Baytown
reviews.text: Check engine light had two other shops guessing. They found a cracked vacuum hose in an hour and charged me for an hour.

reviews.author: Commuter, Mont Belvieu
reviews.text: Called me with the brake price before touching anything, and it came in exactly at that number. Car was ready by 3.

reviews.author: Parent of three, La Porte
reviews.text: AC blowing warm in July. Leak test, new condenser, cold the same afternoon. They showed me the old part without me asking.
